a.org_id,a.survey_info_id ) a left join ( select a.org_id,a.org_name,a.survey_info_id from ( select o.survey_org_id,o.survey_org_name,(case f.parent_id when 0 then f.id else f.parent_id end) as a.org_id,a.survey_no,a.org_name,a.survey_info_id,count(1) num,max(yb) yb from ( select r.survey_no,o.survey_org_id,o.survey_org_name,(case f.parent_id when 0 then f.id else f.parent_id end) as org_id, ) t on r.id = t.survey_info_id where z.delete_flag = 0 and r.entrust_org_id = 94 and z.id = #{zhaAssessId,jdbcType=BIGINT} order by t.survey_info_id,t.num desc,t.yb desc,t.report_date desc

select o.zha_assess_id zhaAssessId,o.survey_org_id surveyOrgId,o.survey_org_name surveyOrgName,ifnull(count(1),0) caseNum, sum(ifnull(o.derogation_money,0)) money1,sum(ifnull(o.entrust_submit_money,0)) money2,sum(ifnull(o.pf_amt,0)) pfAmt,sum(ifnull(o.js_amt,0)) jsAmt, ifnull(t.sunNum,0) sunCaseNum,avg(o.cae_eff) eff,sum(ifnull(o.survey_submit_money,0)) as surveySubmitMoney from survey_zha_org_assess o left join survey_zha_assess z on o.zha_assess_id = z.id left join ( select a.zha_assess_id,a.survey_org_id,count(1) sunNum from survey_zha_org_assess a left join survey_zha_assess s on a.zha_assess_id = s.id where s.delete_flag = 0 and a.is_sun = 1 group by a.zha_assess_id,a.survey_org_id ) t on o.zha_assess_id = t.zha_assess_id and o.survey_org_id = t.survey_org_id where z.delete_flag = 0 and z.id = #{zhaAssessId,jdbcType=BIGINT} group by o.survey_org_id
